page.overview:
Who is Xo Lahru?

Xo Lahru was an Anx male who served the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.

By 382 BBY, he and sat on the Jedi High Council. Lahru sent an emergency request to Azlin Rell to check on the Jedi Kevmo Zink and Zallah Macri, who were stationed on the planet Dalna but had not made contact for days, and was present for Porter Engle's report to the High Council that Barash Silvain had taken a vow to withdraw from the Order's day–to–day activities.

By 232 BBY, Lahru served as a Grandmaster of the Order and convened the Jedi Council to discuss the threat of the Nihil. While the Order were invited by Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh to join forces with the Republic Defense Coalition in a mission against the Nihil, some members of the Order held reservations against interfering in galactic military affairs. Such Jedi included Ephru Shinn, a Mon Calamari who was selected by Grandmaster Yoda as a temporary replacement on the Council. When Shinn countered Councilor Yarael Poof's belief that the Jedi should intervene in the Nihil conflict, the Mon Calamari voicing her fears that such would only lead to further complications, Lahru rhetorically asked whether the Jedi should refrain from doing so if only for simplicity. After other members of the High Council made their stances clear, the Order ultimately decided to accept Chancellor Soh's offer.

Later, Jedi Master Estala Maru informed Lahru that Master Avar Kriss had requested an autopsy of a Hutt trader who had been killed during a Nihil attack while transporting Vratixian barley. Although the request perturbed Lahru, the autopsy was authorized. One week after the fall of Starlight Beacon, Lahru participated in an address in the Galactic Senate Chamber to many of his Jedi colleagues, who had been recalled to Coruscant. Offering assurance that he sensed their uncertainty, Lahru elaborated on an announcement enacting the Guardian Protocols, explaining that combat instruction among younglings would be accelerated and that Padawans could ascend to the rank of Knight regardless of age.
